business_question: What evidence can you find whether or not the
principle applied during that time period on the Titanic?
business_answer_shown: The survival outcomes provide evidence consistent with a

pattern: adult women had a 76.8% survival rate and children had a 57.4% survival rate, compared with 17.7% for adult men. Adult women's survival rate was 59.1 percentage points higher than adult men's, and children's was 39.7 percentage points higher.

baseline_chart_assessment.issue: The baseline title identifies the topic but does not state the principal evidence-based takeaway.
baseline_chart_assessment.why_it_matters: Business managers must interpret the bars before understanding the answer to the supplied question.
baseline_chart_assessment.related_principle: Story / Method — Create a clear visual story and tell the story with the title.

baseline_chart_assessment.issue: The most decision-relevant differences between women, children, and adult men are not stated directly.
baseline_chart_assessment.why_it_matters: The audience must mentally calculate the magnitude of the survival gaps instead of seeing the comparison immediately.
baseline_chart_assessment.related_principle: Perception / Purpose — Focus the viewer on the most important evidence and answer the well-framed analytical question.

baseline_chart_assessment.issue: The vertical bars require category labels to be read below the plotting area and leave substantial unused horizontal space.
baseline_chart_assessment.why_it_matters: A horizontal comparison allows category names and direct values to be read together more efficiently.
baseline_chart_assessment.related_principle: Charts / Signs — Select a chart structure that supports accurate comparison and minimizes interpretation effort.

baseline_chart_assessment.issue: The baseline includes stronger framing, borders, and gridlines than are necessary for three directly labeled values.
baseline_chart_assessment.why_it_matters: Reducing secondary visual elements improves the signal-to-noise ratio and keeps attention on the survival-rate differences.
baseline_chart_assessment.related_principle: Method — Remove chart junk and unnecessary visual noise.

data_fidelity_checks.check: Adult women survival rate and denominator
data_fidelity_checks.notes: Source data contain 255 survivors among 332 adult women with known age, yielding 76.8%, consistent with the baseline.
Using the supplied definition of children as passengers under age 16, source data contain 66 survivors among 115 children with known age, yielding 57.4%, consistent with the baseline.

data_fidelity_checks.check: Adult men survival rate and denominator
data_fidelity_checks.notes: Source data contain 106 survivors among 599 adult men with known age, yielding 17.7%, consistent with the baseline.
There are 263 passengers without usable age values; the improved chart preserves the baseline note that passengers with missing age are excluded.
Adult women exceed adult men by 59.1 percentage points and children exceed adult men by 39.7 percentage points; these annotations are derived directly from the verified rates.

improved_chart.title: Women and children survived far more often than adult men
improved_chart.accessibility_notes: The chart uses direct category and value labels, does not require a legend, preserves a zero-based percentage scale, and does not rely on color alone to communicate the comparison.

baseline_to_improved_comparison.improved: The title states the central observed pattern directly and the subtitle connects it to the business question.

baseline_to_improved_comparison.improved: Direct labels are retained and the two key percentage-point gaps versus adult men are explicitly shown.

baseline_to_improved_comparison.baseline: Relevant data are shown, but the answer to the supplied question is primarily implicit.
baseline_to_improved_comparison.improved: The chart explicitly frames the observed survival outcomes as evidence consistent with the principle while avoiding a causal claim.

baseline_to_improved_comparison.baseline: All three bars receive similar visual treatment and the audience must compare their heights.

baseline_to_improved_comparison.baseline: A vertical bar chart accurately compares three survival rates.
baseline_to_improved_comparison.improved: A horizontal bar chart preserves the accurate comparison while improving the reading path for category names, values, and annotations.
